query: WITH page_mcqs AS (SELECT id FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 464 AND 468), bad_mcqs AS (SELECT m.id FROM page_mcqs m LEFT JOIN public.gk_mcq_options o ON o.mcq_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id HAVING count(o.id) <> 4 OR count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.is_correct) <> 1), verification_counts AS (SELECT verification_status, count(*) AS item_count FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 464 AND 468 GROUP BY verification_status) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 464 AND 468) AS source_pages, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 464 AND 468) AS facts, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 464 AND 468) AS notes, (SELECT count(*) FROM page_mcqs) AS mcqs, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options WHERE mcq_id IN (SELECT id FROM page_mcqs)) AS options, (SELECT count(*) FROM bad_mcqs) AS incomplete_mcqs, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0464-0468:%') AS flashcards, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d WHERE (d.entity_type = 'fact' AND d.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 464 AND 468)) OR (d.entity_type = 'note' AND d.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 464 AND 468)) OR (d.entity_type = 'mcq' AND d.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM page_mcqs))) AS search_documents, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.content_tag_assignments WHERE source_page BETWEEN 464 AND 468) AS tag_assignments, (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(verification_status, item_count) FROM verification_counts) AS verification_status_counts LIMIT 1;
